steps.title: Prepare plant sample powder
steps.instruction: Take 250 mg of food sample on dry ice, transfer to a mortar, add liquid nitrogen until fully immersed, grind vigorously with a pestle to a fine powder, then transfer the powder to a ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm). Add 750 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ Lysis Solution and cap tightly.

steps.title: Lyse sample in bead beater
steps.instruction: Secure the capped tube in an Omni Bead Ruptor Elite fitted with a 2 mL tube holder assembly, run at max speed (30 m/s) for 5 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate to collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tubes at ≥10 000 × g for 1 minute (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Filter supernatant through III‑F filter
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 600 µL of the supernatant to a Zymo‑Spin™ III‑F Filter placed in a labelled Collection Tube, centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 1 minute, then discard the filter.

steps.title: Add DNA Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Add a total of 1 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate (add 600 µL, mix well, then add another 600 µL).

steps.title: Load mixture onto IICR column
steps.instruction: Transfer 800 µL of the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin™ IICR Column in a Collection Tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute; discard the flow‑through, then transfer the remaining mixture (≈400 µL) to the same column and centrifuge again at 10 000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 1 to the IICR Column in a new Collection Tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 2 (700 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the IICR Column in a Collection Tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Final wash with Buffer 2 (200 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the IICR Column in a Collection Tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Elute DNA with RNase‑Free water
steps.instruction: Transfer the IICR Column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL (minimum 50 µL) ZymoBIOMICS™ DNase/RNase‑Free Water directly onto the matrix, incubate for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Optional HRC cleanup – add prep solution
steps.instruction: Place a Zymo‑Spin™ III‑HRC Filter in a new Collection Tube, add 600 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution, and centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Optional HRC cleanup – bind and elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate from the previous step to the prepared III‑HRC Filter in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, then centrifuge at exactly 16 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Store eluted DNA
steps.instruction: The purified DNA is suitable for PCR and other downstream applications; store the eluate frozen at –30 °C to –15 °C or at –90 °C to –65 °C.
